assets.name: pythian-priestess
assets.processing: Original generated PNG copied byte for byte; native alpha preserved
assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: full-body character portrait for CosyWorld's painted Greek drama card game.
Input images: attached portraits are references for painterly detail, natural adult anatomy, woven cloth texture, full-body scale and gentle three-quarter staging. Create the named subject below with the specified face and clothing.
Style/medium: finely detailed painted storybook realism, earthy pigments, soft inner brushwork and an expressive readable adult face.
Composition/framing: one living adult is the sole subject. Tall 1024 by 1536 canvas with genuine transparent background. Show the entire standing figure from crown of head through both complete feet and sandal soles. Give clear margins around the head, hands, hems and under the feet. The figure fills about 86 percent of canvas height. Body at a gentle three-quarter angle, uncovered face and eyes turned toward image-left. Both hands are empty; keep all hands, limbs and clothing inside the canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral daylight with restrained highlights and natural volume, suitable for compositing over both day and night painted scenes.
Output: preserve native clear transparent alpha around the complete figure. Only this single adult and worn clothes occupy the illustration.
Subject: the Pythian Priestess, an older adult woman about seventy, who receives a refuge branch and introduces the Delphi source frame. A narrow lined olive face, thoughtful dark brown eyes, a long straight nose and silver-white hair gathered into a neat low coil. She wears a full-length pale ceremonial linen robe with long loose sleeves, a simple undyed woven sash and practical leather sandals. A small fold of pale linen rests over one shoulder. Her face is uncovered. One empty hand is open low toward image-left, ready to hear a speaker; the other rests gently at her waist. Her expression is attentive and composed. Her age reads clearly and her whole adult figure is natural and dignified.

Subject: The Furies, a collective accusing chorus represented by one compact cutout of THREE adult women. One woman is about thirty with dark braided hair and a long face; the middle woman is about fifty with a broad strong face and dark hair streaked with grey; the third is about seventy with silver gathered hair and deeply lined cheeks. All three have distinct clear human adult faces, dark attentive eyes and composed firm expressions. Each wears opaque ash-grey and charcoal draped linen and wool clothes and practical leather sandals. Small bronze serpent-shaped hair or shoulder ornaments identify their chorus; the ornaments are restrained pieces of jewelry. Stand them close together at slightly staggered depths with all three complete bodies and all six feet on a common ground level. Keep their arms separate, readable empty hands visible, and each face fully clear. All three look gently toward image-left while the central woman makes a small low open speaking gesture. Preserve the collective human chorus feeling and clear space around the entire group.

Subject: Thoas, a mature coastal king about fifty-five who hears a rite and gives his own answer to a pact. A broad weathered olive face, a prominent curved nose, dark brown eyes, thick dark grey-streaked hair brushed back and a dense trimmed salt-and-pepper beard. His bare head and clear face remain visible.
